error.permission_denied: Permission denied. Your account cannot perform this action. Ask an administrator to review your access.
error.stale_revision: This workspace changed since you opened it. Refresh the latest revision, then review your changes again.
error.pending_review: This action is waiting for review. Approval must be recorded before it can continue.
error.config_absent: Required provider configuration is absent. No provider action was performed.
error.validation: The request could not be accepted. Check the fields, limits and consent, then try again.
error.not_found: This item is no longer available. Refresh the workspace to see the current state.
error.unavailable: The workspace service is unavailable. Your unsaved edits are still here. Try again when ready.
error.parent_cap: A binding ancestor or ultimate deadline prevents this extension. No partial extension was silently substituted; choose different terms or review the ancestor policy.
error.per_grant_limit: The requested calendar days exceed this allowance pool's maximum days per grant.
error.allowance_exhausted: The allowance has insufficient remaining calendar days or grants. No balance changed.
error.scope_not_extendable: This scope has no enabled extension allowance or no local deadline/window to extend. Open-ended mode does not remove inherited ancestor caps.
error.inactive_enrollment: This enrollment is paused or closed. An extension cannot silently reopen it.
error.offer_limit: An outstanding offer, offer-frequency limit or cooldown prevents another proposal for this scope.
error.policy_reset_forbidden: The policy engine rejected a reset of established anchors, scope identities, work counters or ultimate ceilings. Review the existing policy and propose a preserving migration.
error.review_invalid: Review cannot promote an incorrect, assisted, obsolete or unsupported result into mastery. The recorded grade and independence remain unchanged.
error.immutable_release: Published or archived releases are immutable. Create a new validated draft instead.
error.runtime_unsupported: Publication is blocked by the installed runtime: a required evaluator, activity handler or visual validator is absent or rejected the scene, or a gate's conversational evaluator names no single cited rubric (name a 0.5 evaluator definition bound to exactly one rubric, or a deterministic evaluator whose installed adapter confirms quoted findings). Metadata does not establish a working handler.
error.impact_changed: The impact changed since you reviewed it (new learners, evidence or content). Review the updated impact, then confirm again.
error.older_version: A newer version of this course is already published. Confirm that you want to publish the older version, then try again.
error.active_release: The release new learners start on cannot be archived. Select another release for new learners first.
error.no_replacement: No other item can replace this one. Confirm that learners lose this route to the checkpoint, or add a replacement in a new release.
error.item_defective: This item is already marked defective on this release.
error.policy_infeasible: The required core path and final assessment do not fit this envelope. Nothing was saved; review the disclosed issues and alternatives. Mastery criteria are never lowered to make a plan fit.
error.eval_required: This provider, model or prompt revision has no passing agent evaluation. Record an evaluation report, or ask a workspace owner to record an override, then save again. Nothing was changed.
error.shortened_grant: This change shortens time already promised by a grant, exception or accommodation. Acknowledge each affected grant explicitly before applying it.
error.ledger_refused: The ledger refused this operation: the grant is already revoked, the refund exceeds what the grant debited, or the item no longer exists. Nothing changed.
error.invalid_response: The service returned an incompatible response. No update was applied to this view.
error.looser_than_parent: This change would make a level looser than the level above it (a later end date or more work). A learner's own terms, a chapter or an episode can only be stricter than the course and organization. Choose a tighter value, or change the higher level first.
error.no_pool_for_unit: No extension allowance at this level pays for this kind of extra (minutes or episodes). Add an allowance for that unit in the course policy settings, or request calendar days instead.
error.outage_deadline_only: An outage adjustment can only move a deadline. Remove the extra minutes or episodes, or use an accommodation instead.
error.cohort_too_large: Too many learners for one batch (at most 500). Choose fewer learners and adjust them in several batches.
error.no_active_learners: No active learner matches this selection, so there is nothing to adjust.
error.pause_not_allowed: An approved pause can only move a relative window that allows pauses. Use an accommodation for other deadlines.
error.visual_inaccessible: Publication is blocked: a lesson visual is not accessible. Its renderer must declare keyboard support and a text alternative, and the visual needs a text description. Update the course package and upload it again.
